_doc: Szadi art's RPG Fantasy Worlds Set 1 (RPGFW_Set1_v1.0): the Stadium's dirt, grass and water blobs, boulders and tall grass, the cliff strips the pit walls come from, a few trees and the waterfall. Keys: tools/cut_tiles.py. Paths are relative to the packs dir.

dirt_worn._doc: g_terrain3's second band solid (tiles 12-15 x 4-7): the same dirt trodden paler and drier (lifted a little: untinted it snaps to the floor's own colours), for the Stadium's spawn and centre pads; square pads read cleaner than its ragged blob, whose stony rim looked busy

dirt_edge._doc: the floor's own dirt in shade: the Stadium's one-tile border under the hoardings

water._doc: a flat 2 x 2 from the bed's interior centres (the solid-looking [12, 0] block is a notched blob with a hole)

dirt_dark._doc: dressing (the Stadium's DirtDark layer): the floor's own brown dirt blob in shade, ragged patches of packed, darker ground out on the pitch

dirt_dry._doc: dressing (DirtDry): the floor's own brown dirt blob lifted paler, the sun-baked dry ground by the kerb (the tan band's rim snapped to grey gravel here)

damp._doc: dressing (Damp): g_terrain3's red-brown band darkened, the sprinklers' wet patches by the cobbled corners

path._doc: dressing (Paths): the trodden tan band, lifted like the dirt_worn pads, as worn lanes between the starting marks and the centre and the dust round the pads

overlay._doc: the pits' far wall: a seamless cliff face from the matching pack; the lip and the cracks: the floor's own fill (tools/cut_tiles.py cut_overlay)

pebbles._doc: dressing: Set 1 loose pebbles, found on their own (as keeps.json)

sprigs._doc: dressing: Set 1 tiny grass sprigs, dried: the odd weed along the kerb
